exact.access 必须是 off / push / full: access must be off / push / full
exact.「仅选定应用」模式下至少要选一个，否则不会捕获任何通知: Pick at least one app in "selected apps only" mode, or nothing will be captured
exact.不能停用自己: You can't disable your own account
exact.不能删除自己: You can't delete your own account
exact.删除用户会连同他的设备、消息、规则一起删掉，需要显式确认: Deleting a user also deletes their devices, messages and rules. Confirm explicitly.
exact.口令或验证码不正确: Password or verification code is wrong
exact.只有管理员能改: Only an admin can change this
exact.只有管理员能改 Bark 的开放档位: Only an admin can change Bark's access level
exact.只有管理员能改注册设置: Only an admin can change registration settings
exact.只有管理员能管理公告: Only an admin can manage announcements
exact.只有管理员能管理用户: Only an admin can manage users
exact.只有管理员能管理邀请码: Only an admin can manage invite codes
exact.启用时必须填目标号码: Enter a destination number before enabling this
exact.导入的历史记录会被保留上限删掉: The retention limit will delete the history you're importing
exact.尝试过于频繁，请稍后再试: Too many attempts. Try again later
exact.找回码已失效，请重新发送一个: That recovery code is no longer valid. Send a new one
exact.未接入: Not wired up on this server
exact.未接入定位: Location is not wired up on this server
exact.未接入计划任务: Scheduled tasks are not wired up on this server
exact.本来就没开: It wasn't on to begin with
exact.消息不存在或已删除: Message not found, or already deleted
exact.渠道配置已失效，请重新保存: This channel's config can no longer be read. Save it again
exact.满电阈值必须高于低电量阈值: The full-battery threshold must be higher than the low-battery threshold
exact.设备凭证已吊销: This device's credential has been revoked
exact.设备当前不在线: The device is offline right now
exact.设备当前不在线。离线时用短信指令问它，那条路不经过服务器: The device is offline right now. Ask it by SMS command instead — that path doesn't go through the server
exact.该 token 正被另一个程序长轮询，无法读取更新。请换用独立的 Bot。: Another program is already long-polling this token, so updates can't be read. Use a separate Bot.
exact.请先吊销这台设备，再删除记录: Revoke this device before deleting its record
exact.请先选择至少一个渠道: Pick at least one channel first
exact.这个用户名已经有人用了，换一个再试。你的邀请码还在: That username is taken. Try another one — your invite code is still good
exact.这个码已经被用掉了，历史记录不能改: This code has already been used. History can't be changed
exact.这个设置会删除历史消息，需要确认: This setting will delete existing messages. Confirm first
exact.这个账号已被管理员停用，邀请码无法恢复它: An admin disabled this account. An invite code won't bring it back
exact.这台服务器没有开放注册: This server isn't open for registration
exact.邀请码不存在或已被使用: Invite code not found, or already used
exact.需要先同意隐私与风险声明: You need to accept the privacy and risk notice first
